idea-plugin.name: README Diagrams - Mermaid and Structurizr Preview
idea-plugin.description:
Render Mermaid and Structurizr diagrams from your README

Preview ```mermaid and ```structurizr fenced code blocks from Markdown files in a dedicated tool window — offline, with the bundled Mermaid renderer. No cloud calls, no external tools.

Features

  • Mermaid — flowcharts, sequence, class, state, ER, gantt, pie, C4, and every other diagram type supported by bundled Mermaid 11
  • Structurizr DSL — a practical subset (person, softwareSystem, container, component, relationships, groups) transpiled to Mermaid C4 diagrams; unsupported lines are listed as warnings instead of failing silently
  • Live preview — updates as you type (debounced) and when you switch editors
  • Theme-aware — dark/light rendering follows the IDE theme
  • Works in any Markdown file (.md, .markdown), not just README

Usage

  1. Open a Markdown file containing ```mermaid or ```structurizr blocks
  2. Open the README Diagrams tool window (right sidebar), or right-click the editor → Preview README Diagrams

Requirements

  • Any IntelliJ-based IDE 2023.2+ running on the JetBrains Runtime (JCEF)

Support

  • Issues: GitHub Issues
  • Contact: support@jakubjirak.com
